name: Nana – Mom Said No? That's Cute
title: Nana – Mom Said No? That's Cute Mug
story: This nana mug is for the grandmother who overrules the parents with cookies: a smiling nana in cat-eye glasses carries a tall stack of chocolate chip cookies, and it is an easy Christmas or Mother's Day coffee gift from grandkids and adult children.

The print is a grey-haired nana in a pink cardigan and a plum floral skirt, a cookie jar at her feet, with MOM SAID NO? in deep plum slab capitals above and THAT'S CUTE. in raspberry script below. The words are big enough to read across the kitchen, on bright white glossy ceramic.

It matches our Mom Said No? That's Cute crewneck sweatshirt, so the mug and the sweatshirt make a set for the same grandmother. Fill it with coffee, tea or cocoa, and let nana have the last word, and the last cookie.
joke_a: When mom says no to a cookie, nana says that is cute and hands over the whole stack. The Mom Said No? That's Cute nana mug from Graphic Tees Co. puts that grandmother on a white mug, so grandkids and adult children get the joke with every sip.
